thread:
Ravi: quick heads-up — we saw a ~4% missing-span rate for /api/search between 03:10-04:20 UTC. ETL lag of 7–12m on the ingest workers at the same time. tagging owners and proposals.

obs-bot: automated alert: span-drop > 3% for service=frontend, window=1h, threshold=3%. incident-id=INC-2367 :rotating_light:

Maya: ugh. is this the recurring pattern we discussed in last postmortem? could be the same aggregation edge-case.

Tom: can confirm correlation. checked the aggregator logs — saw a retry storm when the job hit a particular partition. copying the snippet:

```
2026-03-20T03:12:08Z ERROR aggregator: partition=us-east-1/2026-03-20-03 handler=merge_spans err="timeout writing batch"
2026-03-20T03:12:09Z WARN  etl: backlog=12m workers=4 inflight=98
```

Sasha: possible root: the partitioner logic returns an empty key for traces missing trace_id, which causes the downstream combiner to drop spans during dedupe. I tracked a sample set — ~60% of dropped spans had malformed trace_id from the client-side shim.

Ravi: ok. let's break this into remediation tasks and owners. quick proposal:
- short-term: add safe-fail in combiner to accept empty-key spans (owner: Tom, ETA: 48h)
- medium: patch client shim + rollout to prod (owner: Sasha, ETA: 2 weeks)
- long-term: add unit+integration test to aggregator to cover malformed trace ids (owner: Maya, ETA: next sprint)

Maya: add me for tests + alerting. also recommend a temporary compensation job to backfill missing spans for last 48h (low priority, but helpful for analytics).

Tom: starting a hotfix branch now. will push PR for combiner safe-fail by EOD. @Sasha if you can draft the shim fix plan I’ll coordinate rollout windows.

Sasha: will do. plan: staged rollout to 10% 24h -> 50% 24h -> 100% with monitoring for span-drop and latency. posting draft in #eng-runtime.

Ravi: good. action items summary:
- Tom: combiner safe-fail PR + deploy (ETA 48h)
- Sasha: client shim fix + rollout plan (ETA 2w)
- Maya: aggregator tests + alert tuning (ETA sprint)
- Ravi: provenance/backfill plan and stakeholder comms (ETA 2d)

Maya: tagging: @data-analytics and @customer-success for potential dashboard correctness hits. Also adding regression eval to Redwood Optimize once backfill completes.

Tom: PR opened: https://git.redwood.internal/r/agg/merge-spans/pull/412 — unit tests added, needs review.

Ravi: thanks. we'll reconvene in 24h for a quick pulse. if anyone sees a re-escalation ping me directly. :thumbsup:
